title: West Bengal BJP president alleges conversions at missionary schools; draws flak

ai.summary: West Bengal BJP president Samik Bhattacharya accused Christian missionary schools of anti-India activities and religious conversions, drawing criticism from Christian groups who demanded specific school names.

facts.claim: West Bengal BJP president Samik Bhattacharya warned Christian missionary schools in the State over alleged religious conversions
facts.quote: West Bengal Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) chief Samik Bhattacharya on Sunday (November 15, 2026) warned Christian missionary schools in the State over alleged religious conversions taking place at these institutions.

facts.claim: Bhattacharya claimed that in one school, an authority kept the flag of Pakistan on the table and another school asked a teacher not to wear saffron saris
facts.quote: If in Christian missionary schools there are anti-India activities on the grounds of religion and colour, we will not allow such schools to continue. In one school, an authority has kept the flag of Pakistan on the table... Another reputed school has asked one of its teachers not to attend the school wearing saffron saris,

facts.claim: Christian groups urged Bhattacharya to publicly name the schools
facts.quote: The Bangiya Christiya Pariseba (BCP), an umbrella forum of Christian organisations, urged Mr. Bhattacharya to publicly name the schools.

facts.claim: BCP founding secretary Herod Mullick criticized Bhattacharya for making sweeping generalizations without naming institutions
facts.quote: If anyone has indeed engaged in such conduct, it is highly condemnable. However, making sweeping generalisations about Christian missionary schools in public without naming the institutions involved is irresponsible, condemnable and dangerous,

facts.claim: CM Suvendu Adhikari accused the previous Trinamool Congress government of considering only Muslims as a minority community
facts.quote: Earlier in the day, CM Suvendu Adhikari accused the previous Trinamool Congress government of considering only Muslims as a minority community, asserting that Sikhs, Buddhists and Jains also qualify as religious minorities.

ai.background_note: West Bengal BJP president Samik Bhattacharya accused Christian missionary schools of anti-India activities and religious conversions, drawing criticism from Christian groups who demanded specific school names.
